help.summary: Install Omahedron on this NixOS system
help.description: Writes your Omahedron configuration, copies hardware-configuration.nix (never regenerates it), and rebuilds. You are not asked to open a .nix file. x86_64-linux only.
help.longDescription: Installer A (ADR-0025): run on an existing NixOS machine after the stock NixOS disk stage. Resolves the G0 flake locator ($OMARCHY_NIX_FLAKE, then /etc/nixos), asks a short set of questions, writes flake.nix and configuration.nix beside your existing hardware-configuration.nix, passes the Hyprland/Mesa binary cache on the first switch, and runs nixos-rebuild switch. Agents may inspect the generated flake; humans drive this wizard.

errors.missingHardwareConfig: hardware-configuration.nix was not found beside the flake locator. Install NixOS first, then run omarchy setup.
errors.locatorNotWritable: Could not write the consumer flake to the G0 locator. Check permissions or set OMARCHY_NIX_FLAKE.

intro.title: Omahedron setup
intro.subtitle: A few questions, then your desktop rebuilds. No Nix editing required.
intro.ready: Ready to write your configuration and rebuild. This can take several minutes the first time while Hyprland and Mesa download from the cache.

fingerprint.prompt: Enable fingerprint unlock for the lock screen?
fingerprint.header: Only choose Yes if this machine has a fingerprint reader. After setup, run fprintd-enroll once to register your finger.

autologin.prompt: Skip the login screen and go straight to the desktop?
autologin.header: Useful on encrypted disks where you already typed your disk password at boot. SDDM will log in as the user you created above.
